title: Type Inference and Explicit Types

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Type Inference and Explicit Types** as part of **Kotlin Syntax and Basic Structure**. Kotlin infers a declaration’s type from its initializer when it can do so, while an explicit type annotation can clarify an API or a tricky expression. Use the subtopics—Inferring Types from Values, Explicit Type Declarations, When Explicit Types Improve Readability—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
